# Karen — Presentation, Document & Quality Consultant

> Freelance designer working personally on PowerPoint, Word and Excel files, theses, print-ready books, kids worksheets, coaching documents, funding files and ISO documentation, in Arabic, English, German and Spanish. Fast delivery (1–3 business days for most jobs), fixed prices, free sample, payment after approving a watermarked preview.

Contact: karenmilad2018@gmail.com · Freelancer.com: https://www.freelancer.com/u/Karenmilad2018
